artifacts.notes: Verified genuine institutional policy update: University of Guelph published updated fall 2026 guidelines issued by Acting AVP (Academic) Brian Husband and AVP (Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies) Sean Lyons on September 3, 2026. The guidance explicitly forbids autonomous AI grading (grades must be human decisions exercising instructor discretion under Senate regulations), explicitly bars AI detection tools from being used to support academic integrity breach allegations, restricts student identifiable work from being entered into public AI tools, and outlines rules for third-party platforms under the Ancillary Fees policy.

artifacts.summary: Maintenance review of https://otl.uoguelph.ca/teaching-assessment-resources/teaching-context-ai/provisional-recommendations-use-generative-ai confirmed a substantive policy-content update.
